name: Flaüta pitiüsa (three-hole oleander duct flute)

variants.name: Oleander body, pine duct plug and three finger holes

description: Official inventory describes oleander hollow body, pine plug directing breath to beveled window, three lower finger holes and paired one-hand drum practice. Pitch set, key and exact dimensions not standardized here; no Basque tuning imported. Numeric axes are neutral editorial scaffold, not measured acoustic characterization.
